nodes.label: Sliding-window beats linear attention
nodes.author: Alexia Jolicoeur-Martineau; Rhea Sanjay Sukthanker; Pashmina Cameron; Emy Gervais
nodes.rationale: Nearly every linear-attention-retrofitting paper compares only to sink-free SWA, known to fail catastrophically; using the already-known-stronger sink-augmented SWA baseline instead reveals linearization methods do not clearly beat it.

nodes.label: Sink-augmented Sliding Window Attention baseline
nodes.rationale: Attending to a few fixed sink tokens fixes sink-free SWA's catastrophic collapse once the window slides past early tokens, giving a much stronger training-free baseline than the field has been using.
